title: Type-compatible tool chaining (foundational)
description: Signature original: Tools are chained by matching output types to input types: a tool producing 'index' can feed a tool consuming 'index'. The composer searches the tool graph for a path from the available inputs to the desired outputs. Type matching is nominal, on declared type names, which keeps the search fast and predictable. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
tools = {'crawler': ('seed', 'docs'), 'indexer': ('docs', 'index'), 'ranker': ('index', 'ranked')}
start, goal = 'seed', 'ranked'
chain, cur = [], start
while cur != goal:
    nxt = next(t for t, (i, o) in tools.items() if i == cur)
    chain.append(nxt); cur = tools[nxt][1]
print('composed chain:', ' -> '.join(chain))
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Automatic Workflow Composer, 2026-10-21.

title: Topological ordering of the plan (foundational)
description: Signature original: The composed chain is topologically sorted so every tool runs after the tools that produce its inputs. Sorting uses Kahn's algorithm over the dependency edges, which also detects cycles: a cycle means the composition is impossible and the composer reports it instead of hanging. The ordered plan is the executable workflow. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Automatic Workflow Composer, 2026-10-21.

title: Parallel branch detection (foundational)
description: Signature original: Steps with no dependency between them are marked parallel-safe and scheduled concurrently. The composer finds these by checking that neither step's inputs include the other's outputs. Parallel detection shortens wall-clock time without changing the workflow's semantics. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
steps = {'a': {'in': ['seed']}, 'b': {'in': ['seed']}, 'c': {'in': ['a_out']}}
indep = [s for s in ('a', 'b') if 'b_out' not in steps[s]['in'] and 'a_out' not in steps[s]['in']]
print('parallel-safe:', indep)
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Automatic Workflow Composer, 2026-10-21.

title: Workflow validation before execution (foundational)
description: Signature original: The assembled workflow is validated end to end: every step's inputs are produced by some earlier step, types line up, and resource requirements fit the execution environment. Validation catches composition errors while they are still cheap, before any step runs. Only validated workflows are handed to the executor. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
plan = [('crawler', 'seed', 'docs'), ('indexer', 'docs', 'index')]
ok = all(plan[i][2] == plan[i+1][1] for i in range(len(plan) - 1))
print('workflow valid:', ok)
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Automatic Workflow Composer, 2026-10-21.

title: Execution plan emission (foundational)
description: Signature original: The validated workflow is emitted as an execution plan: ordered steps, parallel groups, inputs, and rollback notes per step. The plan is human-readable so operators can review it before approving execution. Emission separates planning from running, which is what makes the composer auditable. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
plan = {'steps': ['crawler', 'indexer', 'ranker'], 'parallel': [['crawler']], 'rollback': {'indexer': 'drop index'}}
print('execution plan:', plan['steps'])
print('rollback notes:', plan['rollback'])
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Automatic Workflow Composer, 2026-10-21.
